digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and passive instrumentation layer
propositions: Agent-driven dev loop trending cannot be derived today because event store lacks aggregation layer and exposes no dynamic date-range query surface.

Tier-C blindspots (env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug outcome classification) leave no durable trace in event store and must be closed via passive emission stamped by trustworthy code.

Bug causality auto-derivation via blame runs post-commit and must bypass closed-source guard by writing directly to event stream; auto-derived edges feed only classified-confidence metrics, never authoritative series.
Bug-close friction must remain flat by replacing required free-text reason with required bounded --class enum on STATUS event, preserving single-required-argument contract.
Snapshot store must be git-tracked under .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson, not gitignored reports/, to survive synced history.

All registered metrics must report either a value or structured unavailable state with reason and accruing_since across any date-range query, with backfilled values labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified.
